senses.gloss: f. (an adapt. of preced., as if fr. קָטֹן) small room, recess.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 3a:2">Succ. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>ואיהי יתבה בק׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ניות …</he>, corr. acc.) she (the queen) sat in the recess (of the Succah) as a matter of decency.—Pl. <he>קִיטוֹנִיּוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 3a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>סוכה עשוייה ק׳ ק׳</he> a festive booth consisting of a group of small compartments.—[<cite ref="Yoma 15b">Yoma 15ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="S00897"><he>קִיטוֹן</he></cite> h.]
